name: Ironward the Unbroken
description: Reforge Ironward around a core of oathsteel. The general is consumed; what walks out is not the same man.

name: Ashblade, Emberborn
description: Quench Ashblade in wyrm-fire. Costly, and there is no way back to the blade you had.

name: Oathsteel Pikemen
description: Re-forge the pikes. The men are the same; the line no longer bends.

name: Dawn Vanguard II
description: Rebuild the Vanguard around a veteran core — the banner survives, the legion under it does not.

name: Oathsteel Helm
description: A hundred conscript helms, melted down and made to mean something.

name: Warrens Lamp-Hood
description: A hood, a bracket, and a lamp. The Weir has never improved on it and has stopped trying.

name: Long Marchwatch Coat
description: Cut to the knee and lined against the wind, because most of the job is weather.

name: A Warden's Measure of Gravesalt
description: The Watch packs it around anything it has to move twice. Six jars is a season.

name: Gravewarden's Coat
description: Heavy canvas with iron at the forearms, because the thing you are moving sometimes moves back.

name: Salvager's Helm
description: Sealed at the collar with a glass plate. The Vaults are dark before they are deep.

name: Breaker's Visor
description: Slit-narrow and backed in lead. A Wrought does not aim, which makes it worse, not better.

name: Resonant Stole
description: It hums a half-tone under any sung note. The Choir considers this agreement.

name: Wroughtbreaker Gauntlets
description: Built to hold a bar against a moving core until the order stops. Most pairs are used once.

name: Gravewarden's Gauntlets
description: Iron over leather over iron. Whatever is down there does not get to hold your hand.

name: Listener's Circlet
description: Thin, and open at the ears by design. The Choir does not cover what it uses.

name: Warrens Pit-Pony
description: Small, foul-tempered, and unbothered by the dark. Nobody has ever bred one on purpose twice.

name: Gravewarden's Dray
description: Bred to stand still while unpleasant work happens behind it. The rarest quality a horse can have.

name: Gorruk, Oathbound
description: The Oroc agreed to hold a position. Oathsteel is how the Weir makes an agreement heavier.

name: Durn, Sigil-Wise
description: He was wrong twice and kept both notes. This is what the notes were for.

name: Sovereign's Signet
description: Opens the Gauntlet's inner registry. What is written there is the pact's other half.

name: The Perpetual Censer
description: Lit some time during the Age of Dawn and never once since. Whatever is in it, there is still some left. The Choir has a theory. He has never confirmed or denied it and appears to find the question restful.

name: Slippers of the Unwalked Path
description: Immaculate. Not a scuff on them. Making a pair requires leather that has never been walked on, which is harder to source than it sounds and much harder to explain.

name: Extremely Relaxed Hell-Goat
description: It will carry you anywhere at exactly one speed. Attempts to hurry it have never once succeeded and, by every account, have never once been forgiven.
